notes: Guns with stated drop rates and a zombie you shoot to kill make this a PvE Shooter; nothing else in the prompt is doing enough work to name a second genre. None of Shooter's typical shapes fits a rail line, so I took route-guided from the shared catalogue — a single directed route through one continuous space, sequencing the player past the gun buildings and the zombie encounters, which is what a short line with a handful of buildings is. Kept the preset's spawner-npc and building-interior but dropped choke-bottleneck, since nothing here pinches into contested ground, and added collectible-loot because the weighted 1890s weapon table is loot armed from the world. P3 is earned rather than assumed: the guns are inside the buildings, so the player goes indoors. With no user to ask, I followed the author's answer that the line is endless and placed no finish, and the passing train is transport along the route rather than a walkable deck, so no option covers it.
